On Wed, Sep 1, 2026 at 9:15 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Attached is a rough syllabus for a new "Manager Skill Lab" — a blended 6-week program to certify new managers...

Thanks Marissa — this looks like a strong start. A few quick thoughts:

- Add an explicit module on "difficult conversations" with role-play scenarios and scripts. That should be mandatory.
- Include a live calibration session in week 4 where managers grade three anonymized performance write-ups collectively. That helps with consistency.
- Pass criteria: recommend a combination of quiz (60%) + observed 1:1 role-play (40%). If someone fails twice, they go into a remediation plan.

Priyom — want to confirm if we should target cross-functional cohorts (PM + Eng) or role-specific?

Happy to review a second pass.

- Laura
